decisions.reason: Because this standard perfect binder overlaps with the more automated binder, is less aligned with the firm's stated push toward automation, and shows no visible follow-up evidence after launch, management would likely reallocate attention and resources elsewhere.

This fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's core finishing portfolio and strategic emphasis on automation and productivity, and in a growing market a mature wholesaler with service capabilities would usually retain such a close-to-core product despite limited public evidence.

This booklet maker for inline and nearline matches the firm's direction in digital print finishing and integrated workflows, so with organizational slack and strong complementarity to service and demonstrations it would likely be kept while results remain uncertain.
